question: Of the following pairs of surface molecules, what is used by the virgin T lymphocytes to extravasate to the lymph node?
analysis: Virgin T lymphocytes use CCR7 and L-selectin to extravasate to the lymph node. CCR7 is involved in chemotaxis towards CCL19 and CCL21, which are expressed in high endothelial venules of lymph nodes. L-selectin mediates the initial tethering and rolling of T cells on endothelial cells.
